WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT 'TY' AS yr, DATE '2026-05-04' AS d0, DATE '2026-05-31' AS d1
  UNION ALL SELECT 'LY', DATE '2025-04-28', DATE '2025-05-25'
)
SELECT r.yr,
       COUNT(*) AS lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id || '-' || f.line_no) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
       MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_date, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_date,
       MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_loaded, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_loaded,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.net_amount < 0) AS neg_lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) AS staff_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN rng r ON f.sale_date BETWEEN r.d0 AND r.d1
GROUP BY r.yr ORDER BY r.yr

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT 'TY' AS yr, DATE '2026-05-04' AS d0, DATE '2026-05-31' AS d1
  UNION ALL SELECT 'LY', DATE '2025-04-28', DATE '2025-05-25'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT r.yr, s.store_id, SUM(x.v) AS mine
  FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, f.store_key, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  ) x
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key
  JOIN rng r ON x.dt BETWEEN r.d0 AND r.d1
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY r.yr, s.store_id
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT r.yr, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN rng r ON c.business_date BETWEEN r.d0 AND r.d1
  WHERE c.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY r.yr, c.store_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.yr,c.yr) AS yr, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, ROUND(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0),2) AS diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.yr=c.yr AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, st.region, st.format, st.open_date, st.close_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_store x WHERE x.store_id=st.store_id) AS versions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' THEN c.net_sales END) AS ty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' THEN c.net_sales END) AS ly,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' AND c.net_sales<>0 THEN c.business_date END) AS ty_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' AND c.net_sales<>0 THEN c.business_date END) AS ly_days
FROM dim_store st LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales c ON c.store_id=st.store_id
WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 1000
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT 'TY' AS yr, DATE '2026-05-04' AS d0, DATE '2026-05-31' AS d1
  UNION ALL SELECT 'LY', DATE '2025-04-28', DATE '2025-05-25'
)
SELECT r.yr, COUNT(*) AS returns, COUNT(DISTINCT x.return_line_id) AS dist_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT x.sales_line_id) AS dist_sales_lines, SUM(x.refund_net) AS refund_net,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE x.refund_net < 0) AS neg,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE x.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)) AS orphan,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_start_date <= r.d1 AND closure_end_date >= r.d0) AS closures_in_range
FROM fact_return_line x JOIN rng r ON x.return_date BETWEEN r.d0 AND r.d1
GROUP BY r.yr, r.d0, r.d1 ORDER BY 1
